```{r}
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cran.r-project.org"))

install.packages("modeltime")
install.packages("prophet")
install.packages("forecast")
install.packages("parsnip")
```

```{r}
library(modeltime)
library(prophet)
library(forecast)
library(parsnip)
library(dplyr)
library(dataRetrieval)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
site_number <- "06752260"
parameter_cd <- "00060"

poudre_flow <- readNWISdv(siteNumber = site_number,
                          parameterCd = parameter_cd,
                          startDate = "2013-01-01",
                          endDate = "2023-12-31") %>%
  renameNWISColumns() %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
```

```{r}
poudre_flow_monthly <- poudre_flow %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Flow = mean(Flow))
```

```{r}
ggplot(poudre_flow_monthly, aes(x = Month, y = Flow)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Average Streamflow - Cache la Poudre River",
       x = "Month", y = "Flow (cfs)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
poudre_flow_df <- as.data.frame(poudre_flow_monthly)
colnames(poudre_flow_df) <- c("Date", "Flow")

prophet_model <- prophet_reg() %>%
  set_engine("prophet") %>%
  fit(Flow ~ Date, data = poudre_flow_df)
```

```{r}
arima_model <- arima_reg() %>%
  set_engine("auto_arima") %>%
  fit(Flow ~ Date, data = poudre_flow_df)
```

```{r}
observed_future <- readNWISdv(siteNumber = site_number,
                               parameterCd = parameter_cd,
                               startDate = "2024-01-01",
                               endDate = "2024-12-31") %>%
  renameNWISColumns() %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(Flow = mean(Flow))
```

```{r}
future_dates <- data.frame(Date = seq.Date(from = max(poudre_flow_df$Date), by = "month", length.out = 12))

prophet_predictions <- predict(prophet_model, new_data = future_dates)
prophet_predictions <- cbind(future_dates, prophet_predictions)
```

```{r}
arima_predictions <- predict(arima_model, new_data = future_dates)
arima_predictions <- cbind(future_dates, arima_predictions)
```

```{r}
colnames(prophet_predictions)[colnames(prophet_predictions) == "Date"] <- "Date"
colnames(observed_future)[colnames(observed_future) == "Month"] <- "Date"

prophet_predictions$Date <- as.Date(prophet_predictions$Date)
observed_future$Date <- as.Date(observed_future$Date)

combined_prophet <- merge(prophet_predictions, observed_future, by = "Date", all.x = TRUE)

head(combined_prophet)
```

```{r}
lm_model <- lm(Flow ~ . , data = combined_prophet)

summary(lm_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
ggplot(combined_prophet, aes(x = Flow, y = .pred)) +
  geom_point(color = "pink") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "darkblue", linetype = "dashed") +  # 1:1 line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +  # Linear model line
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Observed Streamflow",
       x = "Observed Flow (cfs)",
       y = "Predicted Flow (cfs)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
